Matthaios ft. Soulthrll - Pangga (song title + repeated throughout lyrics): Bisaya/Cebuano endearment for 'sweetheart/darling,' widely adopted in mainstream Filipino youth speech
Matthaios ft. Soulthrll/Ken/Michael Pacquiao - Pangga: exclamation of amazement/surprise from Bisaya origin, used as interjection in lyrics
